product_facts.PUBLIC_CONTENT_RULE: NEVER reveal pricing in any public-facing content. CTAs use 'DM us' / 'book a free trial' / 'schedule a call' instead. Pricing is private — only disclosed on Calendly intro call.

value_props.claim: Posts cars to Marketplace in 10-15 seconds vs 20-25 minutes manually
hooks: 20 cars in 4 minutes. Your team takes 8 hours.
Manual posting: 22 minutes per car. Ventrix: 12 seconds.
30 cars × 22 min = 11 hours. 30 cars × 12 sec = 6 minutes.

value_props.claim: Phone pings 5 min after a Marketplace buyer messages — escalates every 30/60 min
hooks: Lead came in at 11pm. You knew at 11:05pm.
Your competition replies in 4 hours. You reply in 5 minutes.
We don't auto-reply to your leads. We make sure your phone buzzes the second they hit send.

value_props.claim: Car marked sold in DMS = Marketplace listing pulled automatically
hooks: The car you sold this morning is still live on Marketplace. Unless you use Ventrix.
Stop the wholesale buyer calls about cars you sold last month.
Sold in DMS → gone from Marketplace. Zero clicks.

value_props.claim: Founder personally handles days 1-5 of every dealer's setup
hooks: Shiftly makes you wrangle the API. We do it for you in 5 days.
No API keys to chase. We handle setup. You just sign in.
We install it ourselves. Your competition is still on hold with support.

value_props.claim: Track every rep's posts — posted-by name, success rate, hours saved
hooks: See which rep actually worked Marketplace this week.
Your BDC's productivity, on one screen.
Manager dashboard shows every post, every rep, every minute saved.

value_props.claim: Individual reps can use Ventrix without the dealership buying it
hooks: Your sales manager doesn't need to know.
Your coworker takes 22 minutes per car. You take 12 seconds. Math wins.
Top sales rep at the lot. You think it's talent. It's Ventrix.

value_props.claim: Facebook removed Business Page Marketplace posting — Ventrix is the workaround
hooks: Facebook removed Business Page Marketplace. We didn't.
If your team is still posting from personal accounts one car at a time, you're losing.
The Marketplace channel didn't die. The way you used to use it did.

value_props.claim: Same job, less friction, plus the Lead Engine they don't have
hooks: Shiftly: API setup, dealer-side. Ventrix: concierge, founder-side.
Shiftly posts. Ventrix posts AND pings your phone when leads come in.
Same speed. Different sport.

post_formats.name: Cluely-style founder POV
post_formats.structure: Founder talking-head, 15-30 sec, one bold cocky claim, lowercase caption with proof number
post_formats.example: made $X in week 1. here's the exact way we did it. [thread]

post_formats.name: Resend-style launch announcement
post_formats.structure: Three-line spec list + one terminal/screenshot, mono font
post_formats.example: Today we're launching Ventrix v2. • 47 features • Built in 30 days • Free week trial

post_formats.name: Linear-style monochrome statement
post_formats.structure: Single bold sentence on solid dark background, no decoration, brand wordmark bottom-left
post_formats.example: Posting cars is a craft. Ventrix.

post_formats.name: Contrarian one-liner + screenshot
post_formats.structure: One sentence reframing the category, paired with one artifact (graph, screenshot)
post_formats.example: Dealers don't have an inventory problem. They have a 'posting it' problem. [screenshot]

post_formats.name: Side-by-side comparison
post_formats.structure: Two-column visual: 'manual' vs 'Ventrix' with timer numbers

post_formats.name: POV: you're
post_formats.structure: First-person camera, text overlay 'POV:' + scenario, 8-15 sec
post_formats.example: POV: your phone buzzes — Ventrix flagged a Marketplace lead 5 minutes ago

post_formats.name: Tweet card screenshot
post_formats.structure: Image designed to look like a real Ventrix tweet — handle, checkmark, body, timestamp
post_formats.example: Tweet: 'Posted 47 cars to Marketplace today. Total time: 9 minutes. Other dealers: 14 hours.'

post_formats.name: Receipts-as-flex (one stat)
post_formats.structure: One number in the hook, one consequence below it, no fluff
post_formats.example: 47 cars posted today. 9 minutes total. That's Ventrix.

post_formats.name: Numbered tactical thread
post_formats.structure: Proof number in the hook, then 5-10 numbered tactical points
post_formats.example: Posted 1,200 cars in 30 days using Ventrix. Here's the exact stack: 1. Chrome extension...

post_formats.name: Photo dump beat snap (CapCut)
post_formats.structure: Hook image → 7 rapid screenshot snaps to beat → final CTA hold
post_formats.example: Cars I posted before my coffee got cold (7 VDP screenshots, end card with Ventrix logo)

post_formats.name: Text confession to beat (CapCut)
post_formats.structure: One line per beat for 8 beats, reveal on beat 9
post_formats.example: I post 30 cars / before lunch / leads ping me in 5 min / I beat Carlos every day / [beat 9: 'Carlos still uses Marketplace Manager']

post_formats.name: Algorithm A/B
post_formats.structure: High-effort edit vs deadpan static, same Reel, ask 'which does the algo prefer'
post_formats.example: Manual posting (sped-up 25-min recording) vs Ventrix (12-sec click)

voice_rules: Lowercase X captions when in doubt
No emojis in headlines, sparingly in body
Direct second-person — talk to the dealer/rep like you're next to them
Reference Facebook Marketplace, dealers, BDC, salespeople — never 'streamline your workflow'
